text: Highly recommend for all of your showers.. Absolutely awesome... Mounting it was a little difficult because it didn't come with any directions & there are no online videos, but now that it is up, my shower has much more room.

product_metadata.title: Franklin Brass 211-5BS 5-Feet Curved Shower Rod with Decorative Flanges and Removal Tool with 6-Inch Bow
features: Crafted from stainless steel for enduring quality
Concealed wall mounting for a clean look
Curved design allows for more room in the shower
Confidently backed by our limited lifetime warranty
description: Add a subtle design element to your bathtub or shower with this decorative 6 inch bow curved shower rod. The oval rod has a 1-inch diameter and fits standard five foot enclosures. The design and bright stainless finish coordinate beautifully with other bathroom fixtures.
